desc: The Jack AOW is a compact 12 gauge defensive platform built for control in tight spaces. Engineered for defensive use in confined environments—hallways, doorways, vehicle and other close quarter spaces where longer platforms become a liability. Its compact footprint and intuitive handling make it fast to present, easy to manage and built for real-world defense. Features a recoil reducing Hogue rubber Overmolded Tamer Grip and Hogue Overmolded AR Grip; QD sling swivel mount and accepts 2 3/4" and 3" shells. Includes detachable Velcro 6rd side saddle for on-gun ammunition storage.
